Great Food, Perfect Steak
Jul 2026 • Business
Had a wonderful dining experience at Sear Steakhouse in Vietnam! The steak was perfectly cooked to our requested medium well, the doneness was spot on. It was juicy, savory, and full of flavor in every bite.

What really stood out was the wide selection of sauces and side dishes, making it easy to customize the meal to your taste. Everything paired beautifully with the steak and made the experience even more enjoyable.

If you’re looking for a great steak with excellent flavor and plenty of options to make it your own, Sear Steakhouse is definitely worth a visit. Highly recommended!

We enjoyed one of the best dinners we’ve had in a long time
May 2026 • Couples
We discovered this place while searching for a steakhouse on Tripadvisor. It is a bit difficult to spot from the street since it is located on the first floor. We enjoyed one of the best dinners we’ve had in a long time, with three types of perfectly prepared meat, delicious side dishes, dessert, and an excellent bottle of red wine. The service was outstanding, with attentive and friendly staff who took great care of us throughout the evening. We had an amazing experience and would highly recommend visiting this restaurant.
